name: XPRO India Ltd
business_description: XPRO India Ltd manufactures and sells coextruded plastic films, thermoformed liners, and specialty films, including dielectric and special purpose BOPP films. The company generates revenue by supplying these polymer-based products to industrial customers who use them for packaging, electrical insulation, and specialty applications.
key_products: Dielectric and Special Purpose BOPP Films
input_sensitivity: Cost risks: Margins are sensitive to fluctuations in polymer/raw material prices (primarily petrochemical derivatives), energy costs, and labor expenses. Revenue/demand risks: Demand is directly driven by the health of the packaging and electrical insulation sectors, which are influenced by manufacturing and consumer goods activity.
output_note: Industrial manufacturers and packaging converters directly pay XPRO India Ltd for coextruded plastic films, specialty BOPP films, and thermoformed liners used in packaging and insulation applications.
